findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: restaurantdoctor_get_questions · Public sink: restaurantdoctor_prime_cost, restaurantdoctor_labor_cost · Destructive: restaurantdoctor_run_free_check, restaurantdoctor_cost_recipe.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: restaurantdoctor_get_questions · Public sink: restaurantdoctor_prime_cost, restaurantdoctor_labor_cost · Destructive: restaurantdoctor_run_free_check, restaurantdoctor_cost_recipe

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "restaurantdoctor_run_free_check" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
